title: Microsoft Announces Integration of Consumer and Enterprise Copilot and Cuts Multiple AI-Related Features

content_html:
On August 13, Microsoft announced significant adjustments to its artificial intelligence product roadmap, officially merging the consumer-facing Copilot app with the enterprise-level Microsoft 365 Copilot, while shutting down multiple AI features that did not meet expectations, in order to create a more focused and seamless user experience.

According to Microsoft support documentation and GeekWire, starting from August 18, 2026, the consumer version will no longer offer group chats, AI-generated podcasts, Copilot Labs experimental features, and Deep Research; paid professional users will be able to access an alternative experience through Researcher.

Additionally, the product's visual identity has been updated as well. The original cartoon animation was replaced by a floating ball named Mico, and historical files in the standalone application will be migrated to OneDrive.

This strategic adjustment marks Microsoft's correction of its previously overly complex "dual-track" product strategy and acknowledges that there is significant overlap between personal and work-related AI scenarios. Previously, The Information reported that Jacob Andreou, the Microsoft vice president responsible for Copilot, had stated in a post that the app needed to win "the right to exist" by eliminating ineffective features.

This consolidation also reflects the current trend in the AI industry towards simplification and integration, such as Claude integrating Cowork or OpenAI incorporating Operator into ChatGPT. As competition in large model applications shifts from "feature stacking" to "high-frequency essential needs," tech giants are rebuilding the core competitive barriers of generative AI products through resource focus and experience integration.

content_html_zh:
8月13日，微软宣布对其人工智能产品路线图进行重大调整，正式将面向消费者的Copilot应用与企业级Microsoft 365 Copilot合并，同时关闭多项不符合预期的AI功能，以打造更加专注、无缝的用户体验。

根据微软支持文档和 GeekWire 的消息，从 2026 年 8 月 18 日开始，消费者版本将不再提供群聊、AI 生成的播客、Copilot Labs 实验功能和 Deep Research；付费专业用户将能够通过研究员获得另一种体验。

此外，该产品的视觉识别也已更新。 原来的卡通动画被一个名为Mico的浮球取代，独立应用程序中的历史文件将迁移到OneDrive。

此次战略调整标志着微软修正了此前过于复杂的“双轨”产品策略，并承认个人和工作相关的AI场景存在显着重叠。 此前，The Information 报道称，负责 Copilot 的微软副总裁 Jacob Andreou 曾在帖子中表示，该应用需要通过消除无效功能来赢得“存在权”。

这种整合也反映了当前AI行业简化和集成的趋势，例如Claude将Cowork集成到OpenAI中，或者将Operator集成到ChatGPT中。 随着大模型应用的竞争从“特征堆叠”转向“高频必需品需求”，科技巨头正在通过资源聚焦和经验整合，重建生成式AI产品的核心竞争壁垒。
